title: 125 kHz RFID Stickers
description: 125 kHz RFID stickers for compact LF access-control or identification projects where adhesive labels work better than cards or keyfobs.
summary: 125 kHz RFID stickers provide a compact low-frequency credential format for projects that need adhesive identification instead of a card or keyfob.
It is made of either paper, PVC or PET material and has an adhesive backing for easy application to flat or curved surfaces.
These stickers are suitable for tracking assets such as inventory, equipment, or tools.

faq.question: What are 125 kHz RFID Stickers commonly used for?
faq.answer: Best for adhesive low-frequency identification where a sticker format is easier to deploy than cards or keyfobs on equipment, lockers, books, or fixed assets.

faq.question: Which chip, protocol, or frequency options are available for 125 kHz RFID Stickers?
faq.answer: Chip: EM4200, EM4305, ATA5577 Protocol: ISO14443A Frequency: 125khz Read Range: 2-5cm (depending on reading distance)
